def process(loadSp3) -> pd.DataFrame:
    import pandas as pd
    import numpy as np

    df = loadSp3.copy()

    # Ensure timezone-naive UTC timestamps for consistent comparisons/grouping
    df['epoch'] = pd.to_datetime(df['epoch'], utc=True).dt.tz_convert(None)

    # radius and altitude (km)
    r = np.sqrt(df['x_km']**2 + df['y_km']**2 + df['z_km']**2)
    df['altitude_km'] = r - 6371.0

    # hourly mean altitude
    df['hour'] = df['epoch'].dt.floor('h')
    hourly = (
        df.groupby('hour', as_index=False)
          .agg(altitude_km=('altitude_km', 'mean'))
          .sort_values('hour')
          .reset_index(drop=True)
    )

    # change per hour (difference between consecutive hourly means)
    hourly['change_altitude'] = hourly['altitude_km'].diff()

    # keep analysis window (inclusive)
    start = pd.Timestamp('2018-10-01 00:00:00')
    end = pd.Timestamp('2018-10-10 23:00:00')
    hourly = hourly[(hourly['hour'] >= start) & (hourly['hour'] <= end)].reset_index(drop=True)

    return hourly

def process(loadOmni2, loadSatDensity) -> pd.DataFrame:
    import pandas as pd
    import numpy as np

    # --- OMNI2 hourly (already hourly cadence) ---
    omni = loadOmni2.copy()
    omni['Timestamp'] = pd.to_datetime(omni['Timestamp'], errors='coerce')
    omni = omni.dropna(subset=['Timestamp'])
    omni['hour'] = omni['Timestamp'].dt.floor('h')

    # Keep only numeric columns besides the time markers
    non_feature_cols = {'Timestamp', 'hour'}
    omni_num_cols = [c for c in omni.columns if c not in non_feature_cols and pd.api.types.is_numeric_dtype(omni[c])]

    # Replace common OMNI fill values with NaN
    fill_values = {
        999999.99, 99999.99, 9999.99, 999.99, 99.99, 9999999.0, 999999.0, 99999.0, 9999.0, 999.9, 99.9,
        999999999, 99999999, 9999999, 999999, 99999, 9999, 999, 99
    }
    omni[omni_num_cols] = omni[omni_num_cols].replace(list(fill_values), np.nan)

    omni_hourly = omni[['hour'] + omni_num_cols].groupby('hour', as_index=False).mean(numeric_only=True)

    # --- Sat density: 10-min cadence -> hourly mean ---
    sd = loadSatDensity.copy()
    sd['Timestamp'] = pd.to_datetime(sd['Timestamp'], errors='coerce')
    sd = sd.dropna(subset=['Timestamp'])
    sd['hour'] = sd['Timestamp'].dt.floor('h')

    # rename to underscore-safe but keep exact original column name per requirement? We'll keep original name.
    dens_col = 'Orbit Mean Density (kg/m^3)'
    sd[dens_col] = pd.to_numeric(sd[dens_col], errors='coerce')
    # replace known huge fill value (9.989999999999999e+32-ish)
    sd.loc[sd[dens_col] >= 1e20, dens_col] = np.nan

    sd_hourly = sd[['hour', dens_col]].groupby('hour', as_index=False).mean(numeric_only=True)

    # --- Merge predictors (outer to keep all hours; correlations will use overlap) ---
    out = omni_hourly.merge(sd_hourly, on='hour', how='outer')

    # Limit to requested 10-day period (inclusive)
    start = pd.Timestamp('2018-10-01 00:00:00')
    end = pd.Timestamp('2018-10-10 23:00:00')
    out = out[(out['hour'] >= start) & (out['hour'] <= end)].sort_values('hour').reset_index(drop=True)

    return out

operators.customDisplayName: Prepare hourly predictor table from OMNI2 + Sat_Density for 2018-10-01 00:00 to 2018-10-10 23:00 (inclusive): parse OMNI2 Timestamp to datetime and floor to hour; select numeric OMNI2 columns (exclude Timestamp/hour), replace common OMNI fill values (e.g., 999999.99, 99999.99, 99.99, 999.9, etc.) with NaN, then hourly-mean groupby hour; parse Sat_Density Timestamp to datetime and floor to hour; coerce 'Orbit Mean Density (kg/m^3)' to numeric and set extreme fill values >=1e20 to NaN; compute hourly mean density; outer-merge OMNI2 hourly predictors with Sat_Density hourly density on hour; filter to 10-day window and sort by hour

def process(preparePredictorsHourly, hourlyAltitudeChange) -> pd.DataFrame:
    import numpy as np
    import pandas as pd

    # Align hours (inner join) and restrict to requested 2018-10-01..2018-10-10 window
    pred = preparePredictorsHourly.copy()
    alt = hourlyAltitudeChange.copy()

    pred['hour'] = pd.to_datetime(pred['hour'], utc=True).dt.tz_convert(None)
    alt['hour'] = pd.to_datetime(alt['hour'], utc=True).dt.tz_convert(None)

    start = pd.Timestamp('2018-10-01 00:00:00')
    end = pd.Timestamp('2018-10-10 23:00:00')

    pred = pred[(pred['hour'] >= start) & (pred['hour'] <= end)]
    alt = alt[(alt['hour'] >= start) & (alt['hour'] <= end)]

    df = pred.merge(alt[['hour', 'change_altitude']], on='hour', how='inner')

    # Candidate variables: all numeric columns except time and target
    numeric_cols = df.select_dtypes(include=[np.number]).columns.tolist()
    exclude = {'change_altitude'}
    candidate_cols = [c for c in numeric_cols if c not in exclude]

    rows = []
    y = df['change_altitude']
    for col in candidate_cols:
        x = df[col]
        valid = x.notna() & y.notna()
        n = int(valid.sum())
        if n < 3:
            continue
        r = float(x[valid].corr(y[valid], method='pearson'))
        if np.isfinite(r):
            rows.append({'variable': col, 'pearson_r': r, 'n': n, 'abs_r': abs(r)})

    out = pd.DataFrame(rows).sort_values(['abs_r', 'n'], ascending=[False, False]).reset_index(drop=True)
    return out

operators.customDisplayName: Inner-join hourly predictor table (preparePredictorsHourly) with hourly Swarm-A change_altitude (hourlyAltitudeChange) on hour (after coercing both to timezone-naive UTC); restrict hours to 2018-10-01 00:00:00 through 2018-10-10 23:00:00; for every numeric predictor column (all numeric columns excluding target change_altitude), compute Pearson correlation with change_altitude using pairwise non-NaN rows (require n>=3); return table sorted by absolute correlation (abs_r desc) with columns [variable, pearson_r, n, abs_r].
